_comment: Minimum acceptable retrieval quality, derived from the measured baseline and set 2% below it so an identical re-run passes while a real regression fails. Raise a floor only deliberately, with the justification in the commit message.
_margin_note: A metric passes when it is within this fraction of its floor. Scaled rather than absolute so the gate means the same thing at recall 0.30 and 0.95.
_golden_note: Corpus SHA-256 recorded when the floors were set. A mismatch means the underlying data moved and every floor is suspect until re-derived.
